rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 81 and Article 102(1)(d) of the Constitution and Article 4 of the federal law on the election of the President, the Federation Council calls the election of the President of the Russian Federation for 16 June 1996. Signed V. F. Shumeiko, Chairman of the Federation Council, Moscow, 15 November 1995, No. 697-I SF.
